GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./... 2>&1; echo exit=$?
git add internal/doctor/doctor.go internal/doctor/doctor_test.go
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(doctor): N1 — CheckOrphanedAgentFiles no longer mutates identity files

classifyOrphans called s.Load to decide stale-vs-unresolved. Load
resolves attribute content and, for a legacy identity carrying a
pre-ext-migration `voice:` key, RE-SAVES the file to relocate it into
ext/vox — a write a read-only diagnostic must never cause. Confirmed:
running CheckOrphanedAgentFiles against an orphaned legacy identity
stripped its voice: key and re-sorted its YAML keys as a side effect
of merely classifying the file.

Fixed by switching to s.Exists (a bare os.Stat, already on
IdentityStore), which answers the only question this function actually
needs — does a file exist for this handle — without touching content.
This also folds the earlier LOW2 "could not resolve" bucket back into
"stale": os.Stat succeeds regardless of the FILE's own permission bits
(only the containing directory's search permission matters), so an
unreadable-but-present identity now correctly reads as stale rather
than needing a third classification bucket.

Falsified against pre-fix source: a legacy identity's voice: key was
stripped and its YAML re-sorted after nothing but a diagnostic read.
Regression test confirms the file's bytes are byte-identical, and that
no ext/vox migration file is created, after CheckOrphanedAgentFiles
runs against it.
EOF
)"
